meta.notes: Real-time values listed first, TAS rows separate (tas=true). Round 3 resolves every Home-Run and Target Test row: resolution_status resolved|unresolved with a written resolution_basis; region NTSC|PAL (PAL only as a marked stand-in when no NTSC value exists); dates are YouTube upload dates of the record video (precision day). rules.latest_date_wins: When sources give different values for the same record, the record with the latest achieved date is current; older ones go to history as superseded. Evidence quality decides only when dates are unknown.
rules.ntsc_only: Melee 1.02 NTSC-U values only. A PAL value is used only when no NTSC value exists: region PAL, pal_stand_in true, confidence not high. Version 1.02 preferred over 1.00/1.01.
rules.source_priority: Primary evidence beats a wiki table. TASVideos is authoritative for TAS rows only. Real-time rows need a video, thread or leaderboard entry, not a wiki table alone.
rules.region_evidence: Region is NTSC or PAL only with evidence: a TASVideos region flag on that entry, an explicit statement in the video, or (low confidence) an uploader convention or a previous-record chain. Without evidence the row stays unresolved.
